fast.$description: Reduced motion, legacy scale: still 0 until every component reads a role (Q65 migration, M2–M10), so nothing changes by surprise

medium.$description: Reduced motion, legacy scale: still 0 until every component reads a role (Q65 migration, M2–M10)

slow.$description: Reduced motion, legacy scale: still 0 until every component reads a role (Q65 migration, M2–M10)

quick.$description: Reduced motion keeps fades (Q65 G1): the same 100 ms, written as a value because the legacy scale above is 0 here

change.$description: Reduced motion keeps fades (Q65 G1): colour, fill, border and opacity still change over 200 ms; written as a value because the legacy scale above is 0 here

move.$description: Reduced motion: nothing travels or resizes; it snaps

move-far.$description: Reduced motion: nothing travels or resizes; it snaps

shared.$description: Reduced motion: no shared-element travel; the views cross-fade at duration.change instead

enter-scale.$description: Reduced motion: a popover only fades

mark-scale.$description: Reduced motion: a mark appears at full size

zoom-scale.$description: Reduced motion: zoom levels only cross-fade

dialog-scale.$description: Reduced motion: a dialog only fades

enter-rise.$description: Reduced motion: an arriving surface doesn't travel; it fades in place
